channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Kássio e Toffoli acompanham Mendonça sobre N. S. Aparecida; placar está em 3 a 0
item.description: TSE ministers Kássio and Toffoli upheld Minister Mendonça's decision to remove 1,125 social media posts linking Flávio Bolsonaro to a bill seeking to strip Nossa Senhora Aparecida of its title as Brazil's patron saint. The measure aims to combat disinformation during the election.

item.title: Tarifaço chinês à carne brasileira: saiba o que dizem os jornais de China, Argentina e Uruguai
item.description: China imposed a 67% tariff on Brazilian beef after Brazil filled its quota of 1.106 million tons in September, making exports unviable for Brazilian processors. The Lula government is seeking alternatives, while Uruguay and Argentina, subject to lower quotas, have not filled them and may benefit from rising prices. Chinese media follows an official stance, whereas Argentine outlets highlight a temporary opportunity for local exporters.

item.title: Michelle responde a Janja em ato: “Bolsonara de Ceilândia com orgulho”
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro, a Senate candidate from the PL party, expressed pride in being the 'Bolsonara of Ceilândia' during a caravan rally supporting Celina Leão (PP), indirectly responding to First Lady Janja Lula, who criticized her for carrying the Bolsonaro surname. The exchange followed Janja's remarks two weeks earlier at a PT event in Ceilândia, urging voters not to support candidates associated with Bolsonarism.

item.title: JOTA fará cobertura ao vivo das Eleições 2026, com análises da apuração em tempo real
item.description: JOTA will provide live coverage of the 2026 election results starting at 4 PM on YouTube and its website, featuring real-time analysis and expert commentary in politics, economics, and data science. Over 158.7 million eligible voters will participate in this first round beginning at 8 AM, with polling stations closing at 5 PM (Brasília time). The broadcast will include on-site reporters and live segments for continuous updates.

item.title: A fé é livre. A democracia também deveria ser
item.description: The article criticizes the use of religious faith as an electoral campaign tool, warning about the loss of dialogue and increased polarization. It advocates for democracy to respect religious freedom and Brazil's religious pluralism, and that religious leaders should not pressure voters. It concludes with a call for informed voters and a conscientious vote based on proposals, not manipulation.

item.title: Lula dará entrevista ao Flow no dia do debate da “TV Globo”
item.description: President Lula will give an interview to the Flow podcast on the same day as the Globo debate, which he will not attend. His absence is due to a strategy to avoid criticism from right-wing candidates, repeating a tactic used in 2006.

item.title: TSE tem 3 votos a 1 para manter remoção de posts sobre Flávio e Nossa Senhora
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) upheld, by a 3-to-1 vote, the decision of Minister André Mendonça to remove posts that falsely linked presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) to an alleged effort to strip Nossa Senhora Aparecida of her title as patron saint of Brazil.

item.title: Evangélicos são alvo de disputa, mas rejeitam uso eleitoral de igrejas
item.description: Despite the prominent role of evangelical voters in the 2026 political landscape, most reject the use of churches for campaigning or religious leaders indicating votes. A Iser survey shows 83% of Brazilians oppose pastors and priests influencing voting decisions, highlighting a desire to keep faith and citizenship separate.

item.title: Campanha de Lula busca associar caso de menina morta por PM a Flávio
item.description: Lula's campaign begins addressing the case of Ana Clara Machado, killed by a policeman defended by lawyer Flávio Bolsonaro, attempting to associate the PL candidate with this tragedy. The highlighted piece on social media questions voting for someone who defends a 'child murderer'.

item.title: Justiça nega prisão de servidor da Secom acusado de fake news sobre Nossa Senhora
item.description: The Federal District Electoral Court denied preventive arrest of George Marques, a government communications official accused by Flávio Bolsonaro of spreading false claims about the Virgin of Aparecida. While acknowledging the offense, the judge imposed social media restrictions and flagged potential electoral violations.

item.title: 'Dark Horse': PF faz nova perícia em material apreendido pela Polícia Civil de SP por ordem de Flávio Dino
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino ordered the Federal Police to conduct a new forensic analysis of materials seized by the São Paulo Civil Police in the 'Wi-Fi Operation,' which investigates alleged misuse of funds for the film 'Dark Horse' about Jair Bolsonaro. Businesswoman Karina da Gama and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro are under investigation for suspected money laundering and misuse of public resources.

item.title: Vídeo: Cury diz ter sido procurado por Lula e Flávio por apoio no 2º turno
item.description: Presidential candidate Augusto Cury (Avante) stated he was approached by members of Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro's campaigns for support in a potential runoff, but declined, asserting he will run until the end. Despite polling in third place, Cury rejected the notion of a 'third way' and emphasized his independence.

item.title: Deputado que foi vice-presidente do Flamengo tenta alterar MP das bets para tirar apostas esportivas da proibição
item.description: Deputy Marcos Braz (PSDB-RJ) proposed amendments to modify the provisional measure banning betting companies, suggesting the exclusion of sports betting from the prohibition and a two-year period for football clubs to maintain sponsorship contracts. The MP, issued by the federal government, has a temporary validity of four months and must be voted on by Congress within 120 days.

item.title: TSE tem placar de 3 a 1 para manter remoção de posts sobre Nossa Senhora
item.description: The TSE upheld, by a 3-2 vote, the removal of posts regarding the controversy over revoking the title of Patron Saint from Our Lady of Aparecida. Justices such as Nunes Marques and Toffoli supported Mendonça's decision, while Cueva and Floriano voted to limit the action only to content attributing concrete acts to Flávio Bolsonaro. The case sparked tensions in the STF, with discussions on jurisdiction and institutional backlash.

item.title: A decisão de Lula sobre participação no debate da Globo
item.description: President Lula decided not to participate in the last Globo debate before the first round, maintaining his absence from all confrontations. Flávio Bolsonaro, Caiado, Cury and Zema are confirmed; Lula avoids debates to not expose his weak performance.

item.title: TSE tem placar de 3×1 para manter decisão de Mendonça que derrubou publicações sobre Nossa Senhora Aparecida
item.description: The TSE upheld Mendonça's ruling to remove false publications linking Flávio Bolsonaro to the removal of Nossa Senhora Aparecida as Brazil's patron saint, with a 3-1 vote. The decision targets only factually false content, without censoring religious debates or criticism of the candidate.

item.title: Mendes fala em ‘temperatura elevada’ e critica uso político de investigações no STF
item.description: Gilmar Mendes implicitly criticized André Mendonça's handling of investigations at the STF during a tribute speech to Edson Fachin, emphasizing the need to maintain judicial impartiality and avoid political exploitation of probes. Mendes praised Fachin's balanced approach in the Car Wash operation and stressed the importance of serenity in the Court to improve service to the Brazilian people.

item.title: Renan Santos vai ao TSE para tentar participar de debate na ‘Globo’
item.description: Renan Santos, a candidate from the Missão party for the Presidency, asked the TSE to force Globo to invite him to Thursday's presidential debate, claiming the broadcaster had generated expectations about his participation. The request will be reviewed by TSE president Kassio Nunes Marques and follows a similar ruling requiring Globo to include Romeu Zema in the debate.

item.title: Augusto Cury diz que Flávio Bolsonaro 'não é tanto de direita' e o situa 'até para a esquerda'
item.description: Augusto Cury, presidential candidate from Avante, stated in an interview with the podcast Inteligência Ltda. that Flávio Bolsonaro is not so right-wing and placed him between the center and the left. He also criticized President Lula for raising the Bolsa Família near election time and suggested hiring figures like Leandro Daiello for security roles.

item.title: Da pergunta sobre Deus a FHC à cadeirada de Datena: 5 debates que marcaram as eleições brasileiras
item.description: The 2026 Globo presidential debate will be the second before the first round, but Lula will not participate. BBC coverage highlights five landmark debates in recent history, including FHC's 'God question' and Datena's chair incident, reflecting how debate relevance has evolved.

item.title: André Mendonça derruba decisão que havia suspendido propaganda de chapa de Ciro Gomes no Ceará
item.description: TSE minister André Mendonça overturned an injunction that had suspended electoral advertising for Ciro Gomes' ticket in Ceará, restoring TV and radio time for the Union Progressive alliance candidates. The ruling reversed restrictions imposed by minister Flôrigo Marques, responding to challenges regarding the alliance between União Brasil and PP with Ciro Gomes, which contradicted previous support for Elmano de Freitas. The decision restored advertising rights and party funding access for candidates Roberto Cláudio, Captain Wagner, Prisco Bezerra, and Lúcio Gomes.

item.title: Campanha Lula leva à propaganda eleitoral caso de menina morta por PM defendido por Flávio
item.description: Lula's campaign (PT) will use the case of 5-year-old Ana Clara, killed by a military policeman in 2021, in electoral advertisements to question Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) defense of the accused officer. The material aims to counter Flávio's public security rhetoric and associate him with militia groups and banker Daniel Vorcaro.

item.title: A última eleição da Nova República
item.description: The 2026 election marks the end of the era of politicians who participated in the 1987-88 Constituent Assembly, with Lula, Alckmin and Caiado as the last candidates with national projection. This historical cycle ends with the disappearance of a generation that marked Brazil's democratic transition.

item.title: Vorcaro organizou almoço para Moraes, indicam mensagens: 'Meu convidado mais importante'
item.description: Messages from former banker Daniel Vorcaro reveal he hosted an exclusive lunch in late 2023 for Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes in Campos do Jordão, featuring an upscale menu and rare wines. The meeting sparked controversy due to high court involvement in a private gathering with someone linked to legal investigations.

item.title: O cálculo de Lula para não ir ao debate da Globo
item.description: Lula chooses not to attend the TV Globra presidential debate on October 1st, echoing his 2006 strategy to protect his image in a tight race against Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Nunes Marques manda à PGR ação de Michelle contra Janones por acusações envolvendo Vorcaro
item.description: STF Minister Kassio Nunes Marques forwarded to the PGR the lawsuit filed by Michelle Bolsonaro against André Janones over accusations of receiving 'stolen money' linked to Daniel Vorcaro. Michelle seeks conviction, video removal, and R$ 20,000 in moral damages.

item.title: PT mantém caminhada de Lula e Haddad passando pela Paulista e irrita Nunes
item.description: The PT held a walk through Paulista Avenue with Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Haddad, drawing both support and criticism, particularly from Jair Bolsonaro, who accused the party of using divisive rhetoric. This movement strengthens the PT's position ahead of the 2024 municipal elections and the contest for influence in São Paulo.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro vira 'candidato Teflon' e reverte desânimo entre pastores
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, son of Jair Bolsonaro, has been recovering from negative imagery through a communication strategy that includes alignment with religious leaders, particularly evangelical pastors, improving his acceptance among this traditionally conservative group. His image reversal has been described as a 'Teflon candidate', capable of repelling political criticism.

item.title: Na reta final, candidatos nanicos já adotam discurso de time rebaixado
item.description: In the final stretch of the elections, low-polling candidates like Augusto Cury (Avante) and Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) are adopting relegation zone strategies, avoiding extensive outreach efforts. With only 5% and 4% of voting intentions in Datafolha, respectively, candidates face growing challenges in expanding their popular support.

item.title: Mendonça vota por tirar do ar posts que ligam Flávio Bolsonaro a Nossa Senhora; siga julgamento no TSE
item.description: The TSE will rule in virtual full court whether to uphold a decision ordering the removal of posts linking Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) to a project to strip the Virgin of Aparecida of her title as Brazil's patron saint. The session takes place on Wednesday (September 30).

item.title: Presença de Raquel Lyra em hotel de Lula provoca saia-justa em meio à disputa acirrada com João Campos e gera correria na campanha petista
item.description: Raquel Lyra's presence at Lula's hotel caused tension during the Pernambuco campaign, where Lula supported João Campos in the gubernatorial race. Despite avoiding criticism of the governor, Lula's alignment with her opponents created discomfort, with the PT campaign attempting to balance regional support and political relationships.

item.title: Reforma tributária é maior avanço para indústria, diz Gerdau
item.description: Gerdau CEO Gustavo Werneck emphasized tax reform as the most significant advancement for the competitiveness of the Brazilian industry, highlighting benefits such as reduced tax cumulativeness and increased legal security. He warned of potential setbacks in implementing the approved rules and stressed the risk of regressions without sector mobilization.

item.title: Mendonça diz que há inversão da sua decisão quando confundem fake news com restrição à fé
item.description: The TSE reviews the validity of Mendonça's decisions to remove posts linking Flávio Bolsonaro to the removal of Nossa Senhora Aparecida as a patron saint. Mendonça argues his decision targets misinformation, not restricting faith, while Dino and Fux debate compliance with the Internet Civil Code. The case involves electoral laws and religious freedom.

item.title: A mudança na Haas que pode abrir caminho para mais um brasileiro no grid da Fórmula 1
item.description: Esteban Ocon confirmed his departure from Haas at the end of the 2026 season, highlighting his contributions and opening the door for Brazilian driver Rafael Câmara, the current F2 leader and favorite for the seat. This change could mark a significant moment for Brazilian presence in Formula 1.

item.title: TSE: Mendonça cassa liminar e dá decisão a favor da chapa de Ciro Gomes
item.description: The TSE vice-president, Minister André Mendonça, annulled an injunction that had barred Ciro Gomes' coalition from using TV time, restoring electoral advertising and spending for candidates Roberto Cláudio, Capitão Wagner, and Prisco Bezerra. The ruling adjusts the distribution of free electoral broadcast time following the temporary withdrawal of União Progressista from the coalition.

item.title: Chico Buarque, Raí e Piketty assinam manifesto na França contra interferência dos EUA na eleição
item.description: Intellectuals and artists, including Chico Buarque, Raí, and Thomas Piketty, signed a manifesto published by Le Monde warning of alleged U.S. interference in the 2026 Brazilian elections, with suspected ties to Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL). The document raises concerns about foreign influence on Brazil's electoral sovereignty.

item.title: ⁠Presidente da Câmara pediu para falar com Vorcaro antes de reunião crucial no BC
item.description: The President of the Chamber of Deputies, Hugo Motta, requested a conversation with Daniel Vorcaro before a crucial meeting at the Central Bank regarding the acquisition of Master by Banco de Brasília. The messages were extracted from Vorcaro's phone by PF investigators.

item.title: Se eleito, Flávio vai honrar o compromisso com o impeachment de Moraes?
item.description: The article examines whether Flávio Bolsonaro will fulfill his pledge to impeach Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes if elected, given Senate majority requirements and Gilmar Mendes' influence. While anti-Moraes rhetoric remains strong, Flávio's primary focus appears to be granting a presidential pardon to Jair Bolsonaro, potentially leading to a renegotiation of the impeachment plan. Rogério Marinho signals openness to institutional dialogue, though the polarized atmosphere persists.

item.title: MP Eleitoral pede multa a Flávio Bolsonaro por site não informado ao TSE
item.description: The Electoral Public Ministry requested a fine against Flávio Bolsonaro for failing to inform the TSE about the 'Senadores da Direita' website, used to promote Senate candidates during the campaign. The site was deemed official propaganda funded by the presidential campaign, violating electoral transparency rules.

item.title: Rayssa Furlan lidera disputa ao Senado no Amapá, diz pesquisa
item.description: A survey released on September 30, 2026 shows that Rayssa Furlan (Podemos) leads the Senate race in Amapá with 30% of voting intentions, followed by a tie between Randolfe Rodrigues (PT) and Lucas Barreto (PSD), each with 20%. The survey, with a 2 percentage point margin of error and 95% confidence level, was conducted between September 25 and 29 with 1,600 voters and is registered with the TSE under number AP-08579/2026.

item.title: Nova lei muda regras do seguro rural e amplia benefícios para produtores
item.description: Law 15.526/26 restructures rural insurance, lowering interest rates and prioritizing credit backed by insurance. The law also establishes the Disaster Fund with regulation and private management, but underwent partial vetoes by President Lula regarding LRS application and expanded tax exemption.

item.title: Liberdade de expressão é pano de fundo no TSE
item.description: The TSE navigates tensions between freedom of expression and misinformation following controversial posts involving figures such as Antonio Tabet and Flávio Bolsonaro. The far-right, usually a defender of free speech, shows contradictions when attempting to censor content deemed offensive or misleading. The case reflects broader tensions over discourse control on social media, with implications for the 2026 electoral landscape.

item.title: Confira o que pode e o que não pode até o dia da votação
item.description: The TSE calendar sets deadlines for the end of electoral advertising, rallies, and debates by Thursday (1st), while Friday (2nd) marks the closure of paid press advertising and the restriction of the Armed Forces to 100 meters from polling stations. Additionally, the publication of new AI-generated content using images, voices, or manifestations of public figures is prohibited from Thursday until Monday (October 5th), ensuring compliance with electoral regulations during the campaign's final stretch.

item.title: Mais da metade das propostas dos candidatos à Presidência para a saúde já existem no SUS, aponta estudo
item.description: Study by IEPS and Umane reveals that 56% of the 95 health proposals from candidates already exist in SUS, but 95% would require additional resources. The plans address issues like climate change, digital mental health, and population aging superficially, with 47% of projects not specifying how they would be executed or funded.

item.title: Nove em cada dez propostas dos presidenciáveis para a Saúde exigem recursos que o país não tem, mostra relatório
item.description: A report by IEPS and Umane reveals that 95% of the presidential candidates' health proposals lack available resources, and 47% do not detail how they will be implemented. Additionally, 83% depend on coordination with states and municipalities, which is not mentioned in the plans. Organizations warn of the risk that promises may become mere campaign rhetoric.

item.title: Sob pressão para apoiar Flávio, Zema resiste: “Sigo firme até o fim”
item.description: Romeu Zema insists on maintaining his presidential candidacy despite pressure to support Flávio Bolsonaro, emphasizing his outsider trajectory and rejecting strategic voting from the right-wing. Despite low polling numbers (0.9%), the former Minas Gerais governor vows to continue until the end, recalling his 2018 electoral comeback.

item.title: TSE julga retirada de posts sobre Flávio Bolsonaro e Nossa Senhora Aparecida
item.description: The TSE reviews the decision by Minister André Mendonça to remove fake posts linking Flávio Bolsonaro to the alleged intent to revoke Nossa Senhora Aparecida's title as Brazil's patron saint. The controversy sparked legal disputes between TSE and STF, with conflicting rulings, affecting over a thousand social media posts. The ruling is being conducted in a virtual session with a deadline of 23:59.

item.title: Dino determina que PF e PGR investiguem possíveis atos de intolerância religiosa
item.description: Minister Flávio Dino ordered the Federal Police and the Public Ministry to investigate attacks on religious images across several Brazilian cities, following reports of violence against symbols of various religions.

item.title: Quem está por trás da campanha que dissemina desconfiança da urna eletrônica às vésperas da votação?
item.description: Ahead of the first round of the 2026 elections, a wave of posts questioning the reliability of electronic voting machines has spread across social media and WhatsApp. The campaign includes sponsored ads from candidates and campaign service providers declared to the TSE, as identified by independent surveys. Meta announced the temporary suspension of political ads targeting Brazil following an agreement with the TSE.

item.title: Meta recebeu ao menos R$ 1,1 mi em anúncios eleitorais ilegais, diz estudo
item.description: A UOL study found that Meta received over R$1.1 million to promote hundreds of election ads violating both the company's community rules and Brazilian legislation. These paid advertisements, promoted around the elections, breach established norms and laws.
